postings.title: Account Manager
postings.description:
ABOUT EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 



As an Account Manager, you will own senior-level relationships between EDITED and our customers, working with some of the world's leading retailers and brands across fashion, sportswear, and luxury. You will act as a trusted partner to your customers and advocate for their needs within our business.

You'll become a true product expert; that means understanding every feature of EDITED and the methodology behind it, as well as being able to introduce and explain it to a wide range of users. You'll be speaking to our clients every day by email, phone and in person, so you’ll need an intrinsic understanding of retail to build strategic relationships and speak knowledgeably about the issues they face.


OUR EXPECTATIONS FOR YOUR POSITION:

 - Own the health and growth of your portfolio. Your primary measure of success is retention and expansion.

 - Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and manage the full proposal and contract process through to close.

 - Own the end-to-end renewal process from data analysis and proposal development through contract execution. Identifying and capturing expansion opportunities.

 - Leverage usage data and trends to proactively identify opportunities and get ahead of renewal risks.

 - Develop success plans for each customer that define critical success factors, success metrics, potential risks, and clear recommendations.

 - Drive product adoption across all accounts in your portfolio.

 - Cultivate executive, mid-level, and project relationships across a diverse customer base, turning customers into long-term champions of our brand.

 - Build multi-threaded relationships across each account, with particular focus on senior and executive stakeholders.

 - Identify client risk signals, both through in-person engagement and usage data, and proactively communicate them to your manager.

 - Lead regular progress reviews with customers, including quarterly business reviews and monthly check-ins. This includes clear communication through in-person, zoom/teams, email and PPT presentations.

 - Serve as a credible advocate for our products, with a strong understanding of how retailers and brands operate.

 - Maintain rigorous documentation of account activity, processes, and customer interactions.

 - Clearly articulate product positioning, use cases, and value to a range of stakeholders.

Requirements

 - 3+ years working in B2B SaaS Account Management or Head Office Retail

 - Expert technical competence and enthusiasm (understanding of SaaS software or technology and AI competency)

 - Proven success in growing existing accounts and relationships

 - Ideally, proven ability to manage 20 accounts.


PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Enhanced parental leave policy

 - 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)Stock options scheme

We do not use AI to source, screen, evaluate, or make decisions about candidates - every hiring decision is made by our team. We use Ashby, our applicant tracking system, which includes AI-assisted interview notetaking and automation for scheduling interviews and sending routine emails. These tools support our hiring process but do not make hiring decisions. postings.description:
ABOUT EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 




THE OPPORTUNITY

As an SRE in EDITED’s Platform team you will play a crucial role in maintaining and improving our platform. We run the infrastructure behind a product that processes over 170 million products a day.



As our second Platform SRE around 60% of your time will go on projects to automate toil, improve operational efficiency and improve reliability. The rest is keeping production reliable: responding to alerts, running incidents and owning the upgrade and patching cycle.



Our stack is broad for a team our size, so nobody arrives knowing all of it. You will learn a lot, quickly, with real ownership from the start. The way infrastructure work gets done is changing fast with AI tooling, and we want someone who is keen to help shape how we use it safely.



You will work closely with the rest of the platform team and the broader engineering team to build and maintain the infrastructure and deployment processes, fostering a culture of automation and continuous improvement. This role is ideal for someone who loves a challenge and is excited by the prospect of working on cutting edge technology and learning and growing in a small team that utilises modern engineering techniques to solve complex and interesting problems.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING AS A PLATFORM SRE

 - Automating repetitive operational work, and judging what is safe to automate.

 - Improving monitoring, alerting and dashboards so the team sees real problems sooner and gets alerted less.

 - Owning scheduled maintenance from plan to completion: OS, database and Kubernetes upgrades, patching and deprecations.

 - Delivering infrastructure projects with Terraform and configuration management (e.g. Salt).

 - Responding to alerts and incidents during the working day, and participating on a shared team rota for occasional out-of-hours emergencies.

 - Spotting risks before they become incidents, and explaining decisions and trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-engineers.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN A PLATFORM SRE

It’s important for us to look for candidates that strive for excellence with a positive attitude, a strong sense of ownership and work ethic, and a passion to consistently develop and improve their knowledge and skillset. If you’re excited about the role of Platform SRE and the opportunity to work at EDITED, we encourage you to apply even if you only match some, rather than all, of the requirements.

Essential:

 - Business level English - fluent verbal, written and reading skills.
   Hands-on experience running Linux-based production systems.

 - Working knowledge of infrastructure as code or configuration management (e.g. Terraform, Salt, Puppet or Ansible).

 - Curiosity about agentic architectures, AI-driven platform patterns, or adjacent emerging technologies paired with the judgement to check its output.

 - A strong drive to automate away toil, paired with a thoughtful approach to assessing risk before making production changes.

 - Strong grasp of Python or Bash: comfortable reading, debugging, and adapting scripts (including AI-assisted code) to automate routine workflows.

 - Working with observability and analytics stacks.

 - Hands-on experience with containerization technologies, particularly Kubernetes.

Desirable:

 - Managing infrastructure on AWS (EKS, VPC, IAM, RDS) or Hetzner.

 - Operating stateful datastores at scale, such as Elasticsearch or Riak.

 - Experience with ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana.

 - Leading incidents and writing them up afterwards.

 - Planning and running version upgrades of clusters or databases.

 - Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD tools and pipelines.


BENEFITS

 - 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)

 - Additional Health Insurance

 - Gaming & relax areas

 - MultiSport card

 - Corporate discounts

 - Employee referral program

 - If you’re a working parent, you can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule
